© Iconsport / Wart Brinkerhof / ANP [...] The hosts are without Jerdy Schouten (ACL), Kiliann Sildillia, Adamo Nagalo and Alassane Plea, while Ruben van Bommel, Ricardo Pepi, Paul Wanner (foot) and Sam Lammers will be assessed.

Given the absence of five-goal Mijnans and the potential unavailability of Pepi, who has scored three, and Van Bommel, who has netted twice, Til will need to produce a strong performance if the other match-winners are unavailable. [...] Feyenoord have no such concerns, with Nacho Ferri on six goals, Gjivai Zechiel and Anis Hadj Moussa on five apiece and Luciano Valente on four all available for the Rotterdam outfit.

The away side are without Thomas Beelen (broken leg) and Jordan Bos (knee), while Bart Nieuwkoop, Reiss Nelson (muscle), Gijs Smal (ankle) and Shaqueel van Persie are touch-and-go for Sunday.
